correctness.rationale: The cubic polarization identity and projective three-plane covering lemma prove the iff statement. The exact Boolean evaluation kernel yields 64 forms per zero line; independent gradient columns yield 12+32 rationally regular forms. All 576 line stabilizer matrices have been enumerated and applied, giving two exhaustive 12/32 orbits; the representatives have rank-four squared-coordinate Jacobians, giving geometric smoothness over the algebraic closure. Each of 35 lines contributes exactly 44 distinct surfaces, and a separate full 2^20-1 mask scan agrees on 1540 tangent-filling rationally regular three-point forms. Computations were executed on actual final checker paths.

originality.rationale: The object is a natural three-dimensional analogue of Asgarli–Ghioca tangent-filling curves. The structural equivalence between three-point rational collinearity and tangent-hyperplane covering, along with the exact 44-form fixed-line family with automatic geometric smoothness, was not identified in searched mathematical records or inspected current accessible papers. Earlier full cubic-surface classifications subsume the ambient orbit universe and may indirectly permit recovery of the numerical counts, so priority is qualified; the claimed contribution is the new tangent-incidence theorem rather than reclassification of all cubic surfaces.

A complete earlier cubic surface orbit classification can make numerical orbit sizes recoverable by filtering, so novelty should not be assigned to those numbers in isolation.

value.rationale: Extends the natural tangent-filling finite-field invariant from curves to surfaces, and determines the sharp minimum contact-point number together with a structural if-and-only-if collinearity mechanism. The 12/32 dichotomy distinguishes scheme-theoretic line containment despite identical rational point and tangent-plane incidence; the automatic geometric smoothness is mathematically substantive. This is not just recomputation of rational line or automorphism tables.
